description: This Java class 'MorseCode' is an Android activity that provides functionality to vibrate a sequence based on Morse code for a given string. It sets up a user interface with a button and text view, and on button click, it converts the displayed text into a Morse code pattern and triggers device vibration accordingly.

classes.name: MorseCode
classes.description: An Android Activity that converts text into Morse code vibrations.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the content view, and sets up the click listener for the button.

methods.name: mClickListener
methods.description: Handles button click events by retrieving the text, converting it to a Morse code vibration pattern, and invoking device vibration.
